subcategory_text: Configuration management practices are established and applied
informative_references: CSF v1.1: PR.IP-1, PR.IP-3, PR.PT-2, PR.PT-3
implementation_examples: Establish, test, deploy, and maintain hardened baselines that enforce the organization's cybersecurity policies and provide only essential capabilities (i.e., principle of least functionality)
Review all default configuration settings that may potentially impact cybersecurity when installing or upgrading software
Monitor implemented software for deviations from approved baselines
assessment_objectives: Determine whether configuration management practices are established and applied.

Determine whether mechanisms ensure that establish, test, deploy, and maintain hardened baselines that enforce the organization's cybersecurity policies and provide only essential capabilities (i.e., principle of least functionality).
Determine whether activities are conducted to review all default configuration settings that may potentially impact cybersecurity when installing or upgrading software.
Determine whether implementation outcomes are monitored, evaluated, and documented.
